sections.name: The Bridge and the Torch
lines: N
Four people must cross a shaky bridge at night. They have one torch, and the bridge holds only two at a time.
Four people must cross a shaky bridge at night. They have one torch, and the bridge holds only two at a time.
N
They take 1, 2, 5 and 10 minutes to cross. A pair walks at the slower person's speed.

The torch must be carried on every crossing, and they have only 17 minutes.

Can everyone cross in 17 minutes? You have 10 seconds. Think!

The two slowest, 5 and 10, cross together: 13 minutes. 2 comes back: 15. Then 1 and 2 cross again: exactly 17!
